title: Cedar EU restore policy (2026, current)
text:
# Cedar EU restore policy
Status: CURRENT. Effective version: 2026.
The Cedar EU restore recovery target is 17 minutes.
This policy applies only to the EU region and the restore operation.

title: Cedar EU restore policy (2024, superseded)
text:
# Cedar EU restore policy
Status: SUPERSEDED by the 2026 version.
The Cedar EU restore recovery target was 51 minutes.

title: Cedar EU export retention policy (2026, current)
text:
# Cedar EU export policy
Status: CURRENT. Effective version: 2026.
Exported Cedar EU data is retained for 30 days, then deleted automatically.
